title: UI refresh: Home hero redesign, Ludo glassmorphism styling, remove 'Create Game', add new static assets

requirements.summary: Redesign HomeScreen to match the reference layout (header + centered phone hero image + bold headline/subheadline) while keeping existing navigation via onSelectGame(game).
acceptanceCriteria: HomeScreen remains the app landing screen and still allows entering each of the four game modes using the existing onSelectGame(game) callback.
HomeScreen hero section is visually reworked to resemble the reference: header + prominent hero image + headline + subheadline, and is responsive for mobile widths.
Any user-facing text added/modified for this change is in English.

file_operations.description: Rework HomeScreen structure to a cleaner top header and a prominent hero section that uses the new centered device mock image (frontend/public/assets/generated/home-hero-phone.dim_900x900.png) and updated headline/subheadline text; keep all game navigation wired through the existing onSelectGame(game) flow. Compose using shadcn-ui (Card/Button/Badge) components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust spacing/typography/variants as needed so QuickPlayMenu visually fits the new Home hero layout without changing its onSelectGame behavior. Compose using shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add/adjust global utility classes needed to support the new Home hero styling (e.g., hero spacing, subtle background treatments) while keeping existing theme variables intact.

requirements.summary: Apply a modern glassmorphism look to the Ludo pre-game setup UI and in-game HUD panels without changing gameplay logic.
acceptanceCriteria: LudoScreen (both the pre-game setup state and active game state) uses a glassmorphism-styled layout (translucent panels, rounded corners, subtle blur/gradient background).
Ludo gameplay (dice roll, turn logic, piece movement, win detection) behaves exactly as before; only UI/visual presentation changes.
Any user-facing text added/modified for this change is in English.

file_operations.description: Update LudoScreen layout/styling for both setup and active states to glassmorphism: use the new background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/ludo-glass-bg.dim_1920x1080.png), place key UI areas (setup card, turn/dice HUD, win panel) into translucent rounded panels with blur and subtle borders, and style the primary CTA buttons prominently. Do not change any Ludo rules/logic functions usage. Compose using shadcn-ui Card/Button/Badge/Select; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add reusable glassmorphism utility classes (e.g., translucent surface, backdrop blur, soft shadow) and a helper class for the Ludo background treatment; keep changes limited to styling utilities.

Allow LudoScreen (and only where used) to apply a glassmorphism-friendly header treatment (e.g., optional transparent/blur header variant or className passthrough) without changing navigation behavior. Compose using existing shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Create Game' option from all visible UI while keeping existing local start/new/replay flows intact.
acceptanceCriteria: No visible UI element in the app contains the label 'Create Game'.
Users can still start and replay games in all modes (Ludo/Chess/Carrom/Cricket) using the existing local-play flows.
No backend changes are required for this removal.

file_operations.description: Audit and remove/replace any user-facing 'Create Game' wording or actions that may appear on the Home screen (including headings, buttons, menus), ensuring the primary actions remain local-play (e.g., Start Game / New Game / Quick Play) and remain in English. Compose using shadcn-ui components where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and remove/replace any 'Create Game' label that may appear in Ludo UI states; confirm existing local-play flows remain available (Start Game/New Game/Play Again) with no gameplay changes. Compose using shadcn-ui components where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and wire new static image assets for the updated Home hero and Ludo glassmorphism styling under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly generated images are saved under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced via /assets/generated/... paths (no backend image serving).
HomeScreen and LudoScreen successfully load and render the newly added assets without broken links.

file_operations.description: Add required static asset: Soft gradient background with subtle bokeh/light streaks (ludo-glass-bg.dim_1920x1080.png).
Add required static asset: Centered smartphone device mock with a generic Ludo-themed screen (home-hero-phone.dim_900x900.png).
Add required static asset: Abstract soft gradient texture for glass panels (glass-panel-texture.dim_1200x800.png).

Wire HomeScreen hero to load and display the new asset from frontend/public/assets/generated/home-hero-phone.dim_900x900.png using the /assets/generated/... path. Compose using shadcn-ui components where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire LudoScreen to use frontend/public/assets/generated/ludo-glass-bg.dim_1920x1080.png as the screen background and frontend/public/assets/generated/glass-panel-texture.dim_1200x800.png as an overlay/texture in glass panels (via /assets/generated/... paths). Compose using shadcn-ui components where applicable; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
